response: Closed reduction of nasal fractures can be satisfying for patients when performed successfully, as it can improve the appearance and function of the nose. However, the satisfaction rate varies depending on the severity of the fracture, the timing of the reduction, and the individual patient's expectations. Generally, closed reduction is most effective for simple, non-comminuted fractures that are addressed within 7-10 days of injury. In more complex cases, open reduction may be necessary to achieve optimal results.
